📄 Iran Embassy in Mexico honors 168 Minab children massacred in US-Israeli aggression

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Mexico has paid tribute to 168 Iranian children massacred in US-Israeli aggression in Minab, holding a memorial ceremony alongside its traditional Day of the Dead celebrations to ensure their memory is not forgotten.

Hosted by Iran’s Embassy in Mexico, the ceremony brought together around 200 political, academic, cultural, and media figures, highlighting shared Iranian and Mexican traditions of honoring the deceased.
​
Participants included Mexican lawmakers Maria Magdalena Rosales Cruz and Xóchitl Bravo, as well as academics, artists, journalists and students. The event also featured the Mexican artist behind the artwork titled “Minab Butterflies.”
​
Iran’s Ambassador Abolfazl Pasandideh recalled the children killed in Minab, the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, and other victims of the US-Israeli war on Iran.
​
He spoke about how those who have passed away continue to live among the bereaved through memories, their legacy, and spiritual bonds.
​
Rosales Cruz also addressed the gathering, stressing the importance of preserving the memory of the Minab children.
​
“We must not allow the memory of these children to be forgotten,” she said, emphasizing the need to draw international public attention to the tragedy and the suffering of its victims.

🖥 Vietnam, Iran’s Kashan discuss trade ties

📌 Kashan, IRNA – Vietnam’s ambassador to Iran has highlighted the tourism, industrial, and economic potential of Kashan, a historic city in central Iran, saying it offers opportunities for cooperation between Vietnam and Iran.

Luong Ngoc Nguyen made the remarks during a meeting with Kashan Governor Mojtaba Raei on Sunday, highlighting opportunities for cooperation in trade involving Kashan’s rosewater, mineral products, and carpets, as well as Vietnamese coffee, cashew nuts, and electrical products.
​
The official also said Vietnam could benefit from Kashan’s carpet industry and that efforts would be made to introduce the Iranian city to the Vietnamese public.
​
Raei, for his part, called for joint meetings between economic delegations of the two sides to strengthen bilateral cooperation.
​
The governor also proposed that Vietnam help restore one of Kashan’s historic houses for use as a “Friend’s House.”
​
With a population of more than 364,000, Kashan is located about 200 kilometers north of Isfahan, in central Iran.

💬 Pezeshkian stresses strengthening Iran–Algeria ties

📌 Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian, in a message, congratulated the 72nd anniversary of the start of the liberation revolution and Algeria’s National Day to the President, government, and people of that country, and emphasized the expansion of relations between Iran and Algeria.

In his message to his Algerian counterpart, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, Pezeshkian expressed confidence that, under Tebboune’s wise leadership and with his commitment, continued active and constructive support for justice-seeking ideals and effective use of existing capacities, relations, and cooperation between Iran and Algeria would continue to strengthen and expand in the interests of both great nations.
​
He also prayed to God Almighty for the health and success of the Algerian president and for the prosperity and well-being of the people of Algeria.
